title: Multipartite device-independent quantum key distribution using W states
summary: Multipartite device-independent quantum key distribution (DI-QKD), also known as device-independent conference key agreement, enables more than two remote parties to share a common key with information-theoretic security even without trusting the devices. So far, several multipartite DI-QKD protocols have been proposed where Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states are used as multipartite entanglement.
